defect: REPL hook evaluation in crates/nu-cli/src/repl.rs runs hooks on a temporary child Stack created with Stack::with_parent instead of the global stack, so overlay changes made inside pre_prompt/pre_execution hooks are discarded when the child stack drops.

NuCompleter::complete in crates/nu-cli/src/completions/completer.rs indexes `alias_offset[flat_idx]` using the flattened AST expression index even though `alias_offset` is populated per alias expansion rather than per flattened token, panicking with index-out-of-bounds during alias completion.

For/Loop/While commands break out of the loop when an external command exits with non-zero status but return PipelineData::empty() instead of propagating an external stream carrying the exit code, hiding the failure from callers and `$env.LAST_EXIT_CODE`.
Stack::add_overlay in crates/nu-protocol/src/engine/stack.rs resets or omits `env_hidden` entries when activating/refreshing an overlay, causing previously hidden environment variables to reappear.

nu-plugin's Waitable<T> synchronization primitive has no separate writer-drop tracking, so if a plugin exits or fails before sending protocol info, threads blocked in Waitable::get waiting for the value deadlock forever.
parse_let in crates/nu-parser/src/parse_keywords.rs assumes the parsed RHS pipeline is non-empty and indexes its first element directly, panicking on malformed input such as `let a = | {}`.
detect columns `--combine-columns` (`-c`) mishandles column range bounds (such as `0..1` and negative indices) when merging detected columns, failing or producing incorrect column counts.

The `headers` command assigns the full header column vector to every row even when a row has fewer values than headers, shifting values into wrong columns or causing mismatched column/value length panics downstream.

StateWorkingSet::use_aliases in crates/nu-protocol/src/engine/engine_state.rs calls `scope_frame.visibility.use_decl_id(&alias_id)` instead of `use_alias_id(&alias_id)`, corrupting visibility tracking when hiding and re-importing aliases.

LiteCommand::parts_including_redirection appends redirection spans after `self.parts` without sorting by span offset, violating parser span ordering invariants and panicking when tokens follow a redirection.
